Title: GAIL
description: Designing presence with a purpose. We designed GAIL’s IEW 2025 pavilion to go beyond aesthetics—crafting an experience that reinforces long-term brand recall.
longdescription:
Designing presence with a purpose. We designed GAIL’s IEW 2025 pavilion to go beyond
aesthetics—crafting an experience that reinforces long-term brand recall. In a space meant
to last only days, how do you create lasting impact? For us, the answer lies in tactile
engagement, immersive tech, and a layout built to flow naturally with human curiosity. It’s
not just design—it’s emotion, interaction, and purpose built into every layer.
With tactile zones, digital storytelling, and smart navigation, every inch served a function.
The venue layout became an asset, not a limitation—our plan adapted to guide and invite.
From energy simulators to touch-based quizzes, the experience made GAIL’s scale feel
personal. Bold visuals and green textures captured the brand’s ethos without overpowering.
We aim for connection over clutter, presence over presentation. This approach isn’t about
us—it’s how we help our clients make impact that lasts. Because the right design doesn’t end
at the stall; it stays in people’s minds long after they leave.

Title: GAIL METRO
description: At India Energy Week 2025, hosted at the state-of-the-art Yashobhoomi Convention Centre in New Delhi, GAIL (India) Limited envisioned more than just a presence
longdescription:
Ever paused at a metro and felt a message speak to you?
Seen colour, art, and purpose come together on your daily route?
That’s not just design—it’s a conversation.
At Bikaji Cama, GAIL meets the everyday commuter, eye to eye.
We reimagined GAIL’s identity at the metro level through striking contemporary art—fresh,
honest, and human. The design was intentionally bold yet relatable, crafted to cut through
routine and spark awareness about greener energy. It amplified GAIL’s presence not just as
India’s leader in natural gas, but as a brand invested in the nation’s everyday lives. By
translating core values like sustainability, reliability, and innovation into engaging visuals, we
helped GAIL connect with the retail public in a memorable way. Our goal wasn’t just to
beautify a space—but to shape an experience that encourages recall, reflection, and
relevance. This campaign is a testament to how we turn brand stories into living, breathing
spaces that speak.

Title: GREENKO
description: What does green innovation look like in action? How do you make clean energy feel tangible?
longdescription:
What does green innovation look like in action? How do you make clean energy feel tangible?
It starts with a space that feels alive, with symbolism built into every element. A booth that
doesn’t just speak for the brand—but speaks as the brand. At Gastech 2023, we designed
Greenko’s first major global exhibition booth to do more than showcase—it was crafted to
introduce. As a company stepping onto the global stage, Greenko needed a space that
reflected a clear, compelling identity from the very first glance. Our design expressed their
vision through clean architecture, green textures, and interactive touchpoints that made
their mission feel both real and relatable. Every detail was guided by a bigger question: How
does a four-day exhibit leave a long-term impression? How do you convert a marked space
on a floorplan into a strategic brand presence? By anchoring the booth in confident design
and visual clarity, we helped Greenko make a powerful statement. Long before conversations
began, the booth itself embodied the brand’s promise: innovative, green, and ready for the
future.

Title: LT FOODS
description: The rebranding of LT FOODS began with a clear shift—from a well-known rice brand to a future-facing global food identity.
longdescription:
The rebranding of LT FOODS began with a clear shift—from a well-known rice brand to a
future-facing global food identity. It started with bold moves in communication and
advertising design, evolved through a refreshed brand character, and took shape as a fully
developed experiential presence. We brought this transformation to life by building multiple
pavilions that showcased LT FOODS’ global strength while introducing and sampling a new
range of innovative products. The layout was open, intuitive, and experience-led—
encouraging visitors to engage, explore, and interact naturally. Immersive zones and
thoughtfully crafted content turned the space into a live expression of the brand. Strategic
communication design helped translate core brand values into impactful, memorable
messaging that resonated with diverse audiences. Every element—visuals, messaging,
structure—was carefully aligned to reposition LT FOODS from product-first recognition to
purpose-driven relevance. The result wasn’t just visibility—it was a powerful repositioning
that turned a pavilion into a brand moment.
